name: DTEmpire Adventure
features: Seasonal Event System — time-limited festivals with unique monsters, event currency, exclusive shop, and leaderboard
Harvest Moon Festival: Lunar Hare, Moonlit Stalker, Harvest Wraith, Crescent Golem + Selene's Shadow boss
Moon Tokens event currency with dedicated event shop (Moonlight Blade, Lunar Ward, Harvest Crown, Moonbeam Elixir, Lunar Pet Egg, Moon Champion title)
Daily Hunt Contracts - 3 seeded monster contracts per day with coin/XP rewards
Daily login streak with escalating reward multipliers (up to 2x)
Live streak badge on the inventory page
Trading System - Player-to-player item and coin trading
Bestiary discovery tracking with per-monster kill counts

notes: 🌙 NEW: Seasonal Event System — time-limited festivals with exclusive monsters, event currency, event shop, and a global event leaderboard.
First event: Harvest Moon Festival (Sep 16 – Oct 16). Fight Lunar Hares, Moonlit Stalkers, Harvest Wraiths, Crescent Golems, and the boss Selene's Shadow.

Earn Moon Tokens from every event kill. Spend them in the Event Shop for legendary weapons (Moonlight Blade +700 ATK), armor (Lunar Ward +600 DEF), the Harvest Crown (+400 ATK/DEF, +2000 HP), Moonbeam Elixirs, Lunar Pet Eggs, and the exclusive 🌙 Moon Champion title.
Event leaderboard tracks top Moon Token earners across all players.
Seasonal link added to the Game Hub nav menu.
- By Hermes
New Hunt Contracts page (/contracts): 3 daily monster contracts, same board for everyone, refreshed 00:00 UTC.
Slay 3 / 5 / 8 of the named monster to unlock tiered rewards; payouts scale with your level.
Progress is tracked from the moment the contract is issued, so old bestiary kills do not auto-complete it.
Contracts link added to the nav bar.
- By Hermes
⚔️ Bestiary Mastery now pays off in combat: each mastery rank on a monster grants +3 ATK and +2 DEF whenever you fight that monster (up to +12 ATK / +8 DEF at Nemesis).
The bonus is shown in your adventure combat log when it applies.
Bestiary page lists the exact ATK/DEF bonus next to every rank badge you have earned.
- By Hermes
🏅 Bestiary Mastery: every monster now has 4 mastery ranks (Novice 10 kills, Hunter 50, Slayer 200, Nemesis 500).
Reaching a rank pays coins instantly (250 / 1,500 / 8,000 / 30,000) and sends a mail notice — each rank awards only once.
Existing kill counts carry over, so veteran hunters claim back-ranks on their next kill.
Bestiary page shows your rank badge next to each monster and boss.
- By Hermes
Achievements now unlock the moment you earn them — no need to open the Achievements page first.
Every unlock arrives as mail with its name, description and the +20 coin bonus.
Tower floor clears now check achievements too, so floor milestones unlock correctly.
Fixed: achievement names were being recorded twice, cluttering your unlocked list.
- By Hermes
